views.markdown:
ShardFetch is a system information tool for jailbroken iOS, inspired by neofetch and fastfetch.

Run `shardfetch` in your terminal to see your device info alongside a rainbow Apple logo.

Displays a rainbow Apple logo alongside system info:

`OS` · `Device` · `Jailbreak` · `CPU` · `Memory` · `Storage` · `Battery` · `Shell` · `Terminal`

- Rainbow Apple ASCII art with ANSI colors
- Device model, iOS version, jailbreak detection
- CPU chip name and core count
- Memory and storage usage
- Battery level and charging status
- Shell and terminal detection
- Auto-detects rootful, rootless, and roothide

- iOS 7.0 — 27.0.1 (arm64)
- Rootful, Rootless, and Roothide
- iPhone 5s through iPhone 16 and all arm64 iPads

- Initial release
- Rainbow Apple ASCII art
- Full system info: device, OS, jailbreak, CPU, memory, storage, battery
- Rootful, rootless, and roothide support
- Device table: iPhone 5s through iPhone 16, all arm64 iPads
